entries: This world of full of wondrous creatures. I like to meet them for myself before I draw too many conclusions.
这个世界满是奇妙的生物。在妄下结论之前，我喜欢亲自与它们相识。
How is it that I am able to read? I feel as though I do not even know myself.
我怎么会识字？我甚至觉得自己都不认识我自己。
I have never heard of Renault. Maybe he will be my friend if we ever do meet.
我从没听说过雷诺。也许哪天真见到了，他会成为我的朋友。
Your presence here is appreciated. Your music inspires me. I hope that I can inspire you as well, in some way or another.
很高兴你在这里。你的音乐鼓舞着我。希望我也能以这样或那样的方式鼓舞你。
I do not believe meeting one would be a pleasant experience. For some reason they sound familiar to me, as though we have met, and my caution is from experience. But how can that be?
我不觉得遇见他们会是愉快的经历。不知为何，他们听起来很耳熟，仿佛我们见过；我的谨慎来自经验。可这怎么可能呢？
Sometimes my past feels like a graveyard, where all of my memories are buried. If I could remember would I wish to leave some of them dead?
有时候，我的过去就像一片墓地，我所有的记忆都葬在那里。若我能想起来，我会愿意让其中一些就此长眠吗？
I look forward to meeting one, if they indeed exist.
我很期待见到一个——如果他们真的存在。
It sounds wonderous. There is much danger in this world, but also so much more.
听起来真奇妙。这世上有许多危险，但也有远多得多的美好。
You have suffered a setback on top of a tragedy, yet remain steadfast. This is a quality that I seek.
你在悲剧之上又遭挫折，却依然坚定不移。这正是我所追寻的品质。

I feel as though I've seen too much of caves in the short time I can remember.

Something in me yearns for rolling fields and green pasture.

在我记得的这短短时光里，洞穴我似乎已经见得太多了。

我心底有什么在渴望起伏的田野与青青的牧场。
There is much to this world that I wish to know, but this concept may be beyond my ability to comprehend.
这世上还有许多我想了解的东西，可这个概念也许超出了我的理解力。
It has a sound to it, like it was meant to be uttered in another language... if there is such a thing.
它有种音韵，像是注定要用另一种语言念出……如果真有那样的语言的话。
As I wandered in the fog, looking for my sheep, I'm sure that I saw a light like yours.
在迷雾中寻找我的羊时，我确信自己见过和你一样的光。
If you're as brave as you are strong I could use someone like you. I find myself facing challenges I could not have forseen. I always have room for another friend.
若你的胆识配得上你的力气，我正需要你这样的人。我如今面对着未曾预料的挑战。我永远为朋友留着一个位置。
Judging from my appearance, I seem to be a shepherd, and not a very good one since I have lost one of my sheep.
从我的模样看，我似乎是个牧羊人——还是不太称职的那种，因为我丢了一只羊。
Whatever it is that I lost, I must find it!
不管我弄丢的是什么，都必须找回来！
Why has this thing come to me? Was I chosen, or just lucky... maybe unlucky. I shall make the best of it.
这东西为什么会落到我手上？我是被选中了，还是只是走运……也许是倒霉。我要尽力而为。
This only raises more questions. What is mana? Where does it come from?
这只会引出更多疑问。什么是法力？它从何而来？
I'm afraid I don't have many stories to tell. But we can make new stories together.
恐怕我没什么故事可讲。不过，我们可以一起创造新的故事。
I would very much like to meet one. Imagine, being surrounded by books all day long. Fascinating.
我非常想见一位。想象一下，整天被书环绕。多迷人。
I will put aside fears and judgements based on outward appearance. I can sense that your heart is kind.
我会放下基于外表的恐惧与评判。我能感到，你的心是善良的。
Thanks for helping me find my sheep... or whatever it is that I'm looking for.
谢谢你帮我找羊……或者不管我在找的那东西是什么。
Who's a good boy? I don't know what I'd have done if you hadn't found me.
谁是乖狗狗？要不是你找到我，我真不知道会怎样。
My mother used to wear a piece of silver jewelry for protection. ...  What a strange memory.
我母亲从前会戴一件银饰护身。……多么奇怪的记忆。
Even after being trapped underground you still love the caves don't you? I suppose it wasn't the cave's fault, after all.
就算被困在地下过，你还是喜欢洞穴，对吧？我想，这毕竟不是洞穴的错。
I know the elders warned me not to enter it, but I felt compelled. I had to find what I'd lost.
我知道长辈们警告过不要进去，可我有种无法抗拒的冲动。我必须找回丢失的东西。
An impressive and scary title, for sure. I wonder if we can really blame him for our present troubles.
确实是个又唬人又吓人的头衔。我在想，我们真能把眼下的麻烦都归咎于他吗？
Emerisk is my home. I left in search of something.
埃梅里斯克，是我的家。我离开，是为了寻找某样东西。
